authorization: Latest user mandates actual strategy/risk replacement, allows interim lower economics and main changes. Supersedes old default-preservation and promotion gates; never waives ownership/money/causality.

forecast.normalization: completed horizon return / completed20-day RMS / sqrt(horizon), clip each to [-1,1], average
forecast.history: completed candles only; no macro/crowding dependency

families.trend: continuous signed forecast; spot long/cash, coin bidirectional
families.shock: prior20-day 2sigma downward shock followed by completed close recovery, or upward shock failure for coin; at most3days, decays to zero
families.downside: standalone negative trend for coin; no old primary/macro priority
families.carry: independent spot-long/perp-short legs, positive lagged seven-day settled funding; two fully funded wallets and costs; daily basis is non-executable proxy
families.state: trend outside abs forecast>=.35, otherwise shock; admitted only with complementary net daily changes in disjoint eras

screen.type: independent coarse daily wallet proxy, not native/manual-session proof
screen.entry: net positive in2of3eras; state also net improvement over components in2eras and correlation<.8; carry includes matched spot+perp fees and liquidation funding constraint
screen.repair: only one observed cause-specific alteration; no grid search

finite_accounts.starts: unchanged original primary starts strictly inside window
finite_accounts.budget: max baseline+one selected new core per repo per window; additional actual entrant only if distinct mechanism has demonstrated improvement
finite_accounts.proxy_warning: Spot OHLC stops; Coin actual historical prints where present, unknown coverage preserved
finite_accounts.estimate: 8 Spot quarter wallets seconds/minutes; max8 Coin quarters ~30-90minutes serial; no795/full vault scan

development_adoption: Actual core replacement required even when old economic targets are unmet. Prefer positive cross-era net signal, lower costs/drawdown or explicit BTC role differentiation; phase loss permitted and disclosed. Reject financial/ownership failure. If all mechanisms lack edge, install simplest continuous beta/risk core as development and record alpha unproven, not profitability qualification.
verification: Necessary targeted new money/causality checks during development; full software once each at end, failures scope-only; actual account source frozen; no private-account writes.
old_evidence: All original failures/results remain development-contaminated historical evidence, never fresh OOS. Old forward consumers remain source-bound, no reset/rebind.

carry.wallets: equal independently cold-funded halves; shared BTC quantity bounded by actual cash and37% perpetual collateral+reserve
carry.proxy: daily synchronous fill assumption and daily open funding mark; cannot admit native without executable paired evidence
